title: Interface Badge / Authority Transfer

source_refs.author: Contemporary platform interfaces
source_refs.title: Verification, status, and notification badge artifacts

observed_structure: a small interface mark changes how a person, message, or object is treated
social authority migrates from behavior to a platform-owned indicator
removal, duplication, or contradiction of the mark changes access or credibility
cinematic_affordances: badge appears peripherally before affecting behavior
same face framed differently after status change
physical environment echoes interface hierarchy without copying UI
cultural_scope: time-sensitive contemporary platform culture; verify current interface conventions before literal use
misuse_risks: screen graphics explaining the entire conflict
transferable_structure: a minimal system-owned marker redistributes social authority and changes access, trust, or behavior
non_transferable_surface: specific current logos, proprietary interface copies, or meme references without provenance
